newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-INDIA 52-3 NEEDING 427 AGAINST S.AFRICA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA 52-3 NEEDING 427 AGAINST S.AFRICA.

text.p: India were 52 for three in their second innings, needing 427 for victory against South Africa at the close of the fourth day of the second test in Cape Town on Sunday.

Scores: South Africa 529-7 declared (G.Kirsten 103, D.Cullinan 77, B.McMillan 103 not out, L.Klusener 102 not out) and 256-6 (A.Hudson 55, D.Cullinan 55, B.McMillan 59 not out), India 359 (S.Tendulkar 169, M.Azharuddin 115) and 52 for three.
